texts:
Week 6 left good roles behind ugly box scores and gave touchdowns to players whose usage did not earn them. The buys and sells, each with a price.

Best buy: Emeka Egbuka before Baker Mayfield is back.
Best sell: Drake Maye.
Let's get to it.
#GoBucs #NEPats

Emeka Egbuka, TB WR: 16 targets vs PIT, 37 percent of the throws, and only 48 yards with a backup throwing. Mayfield is set to practice Wednesday.
WR22 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a WR3.
#GoBucs

Bucky Irving, TB RB: 19 carries for 46 into loaded boxes, and Kenny Gainwell had 2. The volume is his, and Mayfield opens the field back up.
RB17 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer an RB3 and a bench WR.
#GoBucs

Kyren Williams, LAR RB: 72 percent of the snaps to Blake Corum's 28, and Corum's two straight TDs keep the price down. Davante Adams is out 6 to 10 weeks.
RB12 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a WR3 and a bench RB.
#RamsHouse

Chase Brown, CIN RB: out-snapped Samaje Perine 38 to 33 in Week 5 but has 22 carries for 48 over his last two games, and the bye let that number sit.
RB6 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer an RB2 and a WR3.
#WhoDey

A.J. Brown, NE WR: 10 targets in his first game off IR, 31 percent of the throws, and a career-high 3 drops. Romeo Doubs is on IR.
WR24 rest of season for me. Trade for him on the drops; offer a WR3.
#NEPats

Ashton Jeanty, LV RB: 58 percent of the snaps and out-touched Mike Washington Jr. 14 to 10. The role shrank less than the price did.
RB8 rest of season for me. Trade for him while his manager is nervous; offer a high-end RB2.
#RaiderNation

Malik Nabers, NYG WR: 15 targets and 12 for 165 vs NO, a week after 20 targets. No Week 7 starter is named, and the targets come no matter who throws.
WR14 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a WR2.
#NYGiants

Lamar Jackson, BAL QB: two straight missed games with the ankle, and his coach said he could practice Wednesday.
QB2 rest of season for me. Trade for him before Wednesday's report; offer a WR2.
#RavensFlock

Chuba Hubbard, CAR RB: 28 carries for 120 and a TD, and no other Carolina back had more than 1.
RB25 rest of season for me. Offer a WR3.

Matthew Golden, GB WR: 86 percent of the snaps, 13 targets, two dropped scores.
WR37 for me. Offer a WR3.
#KeepPounding #GoPackGo

Trey McBride, ARI TE: a team-high 9 targets after 10 or more in each of his first four games.
TE2 rest of season for me. Offer a WR2.

Rashee Rice, KC WR: targets 2, 6, 9 before the hamstring.
WR20 for me. Offer a WR3 before he practices.
#BirdGang #ChiefsKingdom

Caleb Williams, CHI QB: 30 of 36 for 305 in his return. QB10 rest of season for me. Offer a WR3 in superflex, a bench receiver in 1-QB.

Luther Burden III, CHI WR: 8 of 8 for 95 on about 18 routes.
WR28 for me. Offer a WR4 and a bench RB.
#DaBears

Now the sells.

Drake Maye, NE QB: 10 TD passes on 103 attempts over three games, 9.7 percent. Three linemen are hurt before a short week at CHI.
QB11 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a WR2 in superflex, a WR3 in 1-QB.
#NEPats

Rhamondre Stevenson, NE RB: 41 snaps but 14 for 36, while Corey Kiner ran 11 for 57 and TreVeyon Henderson is back.
RB24 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a bench WR with a full-time role.
#NEPats

Hunter Henry, NE TE: TDs in Weeks 5 and 6 after none in the first four, and under 50 yards in five of six games.
TE18 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a bench WR with a full-time role.
#NEPats

Javonte Williams, DAL RB: 11 carries for 41 and a TD at GB, and Dallas ran for 48 as a team. The touchdowns carry a back under 4 yards a carry.
RB11 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a WR2.
#DallasCowboys

Alvin Kamara, NO RB: 19 snaps and a seat for the fourth quarter, while Kendre Miller ran 20 times. The 31-yard TD catch is what people will pay for.
RB45 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a bench WR with a weekly role.
#Saints

Woody Marks, HOU RB: 78 percent of the snaps at JAX, but David Montgomery is week to week and Houston is off in Week 8.
RB40 rest of season for me. Trade him away after the NYG game; ask for a bench WR with a full-time role.
#HTownMade

Braelon Allen, NYJ RB: 87 percent of the snaps and 17 for 78 with Breece Hall out a third game. Hall is due to practice Wednesday.
RB49 rest of season for me with Hall healthy. Trade him away; ask for a WR3 with a full-time role.
#JetUp

Jaylen Waddle, DEN WR: 4 for 24 on 65 percent of the snaps vs SEA, then a shoulder injury.
WR15 for me. Trade him away once he practices; ask for a WR3 who gets targets.

Tre Tucker, LV WR: 2 TDs on 7 targets.
WR57 for me. Ask for a bench RB.
#BroncosCountry #RaiderNation

Josh Downs, IND WR: 4 for 40 on 8 targets, while Keenan Allen drew 9, 9 and 11 in Weeks 4 to 6.
WR36 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a bench RB.

Matthew Stafford, LAR QB: 222 yards and no Adams.
QB13 for me. Ask for a WR3 in superflex.
#ForTheShoe #RamsHouse

Brian Thomas Jr., JAX WR: benched for the second half, 0 catches two straight games, then a bye.
WR42 for me. Ask for a bench receiver.

Justin Herbert, LAC QB: no 15-point game in six, and the play-caller is in question.
QB16 for me. Ask for a streaming QB.
#DUUUVAL #BoltUp

The one trade to make today: Emeka Egbuka, while his manager stares at 48 yards on 16 targets and Mayfield is a day from practice.

Offer a WR3.
#GoBucs

Every buy and sell with its price is on the site. Follow @FF_ChefHazy for the rest of the week's calls, and repost this for your league.

https://fantasykitchenff.com/butcher.html?week=7
